citations.claim: At step 205 EW is already red in all-red before NS, so EW yellow ended after steps 202-204 only (3s vs required 5s)
EW yellow begins at step 202 while NS waits with large queues
EW yellow still active at step 204, one step before premature red
EW was green at step 201 just before yellow, showing normal green-yellow entry

counterfactual.change: Set actuated true->false only; fixed-time cycle lets yellows run full 5 s, so no yellow_duration violation in 205 steps.

explanation: Actuated controller with long-waiting NS queues (N wait 74 queue 16 at step 204) recalls/truncates the active EW yellow: EW yellow runs only steps 202-204 (3 s) then forced to all-red at step 205, violating required yellow_seconds=5. Disabling actuation removes the truncation and the violation, confirming recall logic cuts yellow short instead of only cutting green.
vision_note: The east-west approaches display yellow signals in steps 202 through 204 and then turn red in step 205. The intersection is all red at step 205 after only three seconds of yellow, cutting the clearance short.
